blocks.text: UPDATE: 3 fires hit Cebu on All Saints’ Day CEBU CITY, Philippines — Fire has broken out in Barangay Lahug in Cebu City’s north district, the Bureau of Fire Protection in Central Visayas confirmed. Responders continued to try to put out the blaze as of 6 p.m. The fire was reported on Wilson Street in the said barangay.
